تضطبنون (form VIII)
# تَضْطَبِنُونَ (taḍṭabinūna) /tadˤ.tˤa.bi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
# تُضْطَبَنُونَ (tuḍṭabanūna) /tudˤ.tˤa.ba.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَبَنَ (iḍṭabana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
